title: Photochemistry
description: High in Titan's air, ultraviolet sunlight splits methane and nitrogen, and the fragments build the haze. Unlocks the Photochemical Reactor and Kekule's Dream.

puzzle.goal: Light crosses a path l through a solution of concentration c of a molecule that absorbs with molar absorptivity ε. Write the absorbance A, the logarithm of how much the light is dimmed.
puzzle.name: Beer-Lambert law
puzzle.ask: Find A for methane photolysis: ε = @{ε} L/mol·cm, c = @{c} mol/L, l = @{l} cm.
puzzle.method: Each thin slice of the cell takes the same fraction of what reaches it: dI/I = −εc·dx, so the light falls exponentially.
